## Release notes

Wyrm for iPhone 0.18.24 is the biggest update since 0.18.12. Your settings now
live in your account, you can play with the phone upright, and Wyrm runs cooler
and smoother. I also fixed the drops that kicked some of you out right after
you spawned. Sorry about those, and thanks for sticking with it.

### What's new

- **Your settings follow your account.** Log in on any device and your controls,
  skin, look and arena background come back, even ones you set on Android. Log
  out now sits at the bottom of Settings.
- **Play upright.** Turn on Portrait in Settings â€º Controls and the lobby, the
  match and the layout editor stand up. Upright you steer with the arrow, with
  no left or right hand to choose, and each way you hold the phone keeps its
  own layout.
- **8 new arena floors,** including true Black.
- **Performance modes.** Choose Auto, Balanced or Performance, and set an FPS
  limit if you like, up to 120 Hz on ProMotion iPhones. Wyrm now rests while
  you're in the menus. When Auto slows down for heat or Low Power Mode, a small
  chip in the arena tells you.
- **Remember your last run.** The lobby shows your last score, kills and time,
  and in your next match the minimap has a red dot where you went down.
- **Best for you.** The arena picker puts the arena with the lowest ping on top.
- **A smarter joystick.** The knob follows your snake, and with assist on, a
  laser shows where your snake is heading.
- **Never miss a thing.** Notifications arrive live while Wyrm is open, red
  badges lead you straight to what's new, and alerts show bold, lists and links
  properly.
- **Fresh looks** for voice rooms and the Foods page. Battledome's Play button
  now counts down and takes you straight into the event.

### Fixed

- Custom skins could get you dropped from the arena right after spawning.
  Almost every custom skin made on iPhone was affected.
- Alerts showed their text as one long paragraph, and sometimes raw ids.

### Heads up

- **Trails is switched off for now** while I finish it properly. Its page tells
  you what's coming.
- **Live voice on iPhone is still on its way.** Voice rooms look new, and the
  call page says plainly what works today.
- **Team Mode is still paused.**
- **Manual backups are gone.** Your account keeps your settings instead, and
  logging out clears them from the phone.

---

## Changelog

All notable changes since the last release, 0.18.12 (79). This beta also
includes the test builds 80 to 90, which were never released.

### [0.18.24] (91) â€” 2026-10-02

#### Added
- **Account-linked settings.** Every setting is saved to your account: one
  copy per platform, plus a shared part for skin, look, arena background,
  in-game name, joystick laser, portrait play and performance mode, which
  carries across iPhone and Android. Settings come back during the log-in
  animation.
- **Log out** at the bottom of Settings, with a confirmation and a "could not
  save" screen.
- **Portrait play** (Settings â€º Controls â€º Play orientation, also in the layout
  editor), with a separate layout for each orientation. The upright Ready Room
  puts Play within reach of your thumb, and the phone's own keyboard is used
  for your name.
- **Arrow steering upright.** Both joystick modes are off while the phone is
  upright. Your sideways choice is kept.
- **Arena floors:** Black (true black), Midnight, Carbon, Abyss, Nebula, Dot
  grid, Contours and Scales.
- **Settings â€º Performance:** Auto (the default), Balanced or Performance,
  plus an FPS limit, with 120 Hz on ProMotion. Auto reacts to heat and Low
  Power Mode, and a HUD chip says so ("Low Power Mode Â· 60 FPS").
- **Last run:** a lobby card with score, kills and time after a run, and a red
  dot on the next match's minimap where the last run ended.
- **Arena picker:** a "Best for you" row (lowest measured ping), and Recent
  sorted by ping.
- **Joystick:** the knob stays on your snake's heading, and an assist laser for
  joystick mode comes with a length slider and a live preview.
- **Live notifications** while the app is open, and red count badges from the
  tab to the row to the item.
- **Battledome:** Play counts down to the start, then enters the event's arena.
  There is also a Copy IP button.
- **Arena background size:** an editor drawn over the arena.
- **Foods page** redesigned, with a live preview and shape tiles.
- **Voice rooms** redesigned: official rooms, a room page, round tiles, and an
  8-box room code.
- **Reports:** arena-drop reports and crash reports. "Always send" is in Help &
  feedback â€º Reports.
- **About Wyrm:** a Discord invite.

#### Changed
- Wyrm draws only what you can see, and menus idle instead of rendering the
  arena behind them.
- Network polling is faster once you are in an arena.
- A blank in-game name is allowed.
- The lobby's name card no longer shows the "up to 24 letters" line, and the
  Ready Room shows the real Wyrm mark.
- Trails is switched off while it is finished. The Social card opens a page
  that explains what's coming.

#### Removed
- Manual backups. Your account holds your settings now.

#### Fixed
- **Arena drops right after spawning with a custom skin.** iPhone skins
  repeated every pattern to 256 beads; the skin is now trimmed to the arena's
  300-byte limit.
- **Alerts** now keep their paragraphs and lists, and no longer show raw ids.

#### Security & privacy
- Settings saved to your account are cleared from the phone when you log out.
- Crash and drop reports are sent only with your OK, or with Always send turned
  on. They never include passwords, keys or messages.
